reason: In pkg/expr/reader.go:194-200, enableSqlExpressions works out `enabled := !IsEnabledGlobally(FlagSqlExpressions)` but returns false on both branches, so ReadQuery (reader.go:129-131) always fails with "sqlExpressions is not implemented" whether or not the flag is set. The same patch also strips SQL dependencies from go.mod and adds pkg/expr/sql/db.go, so turning the feature off may be deliberate, but the flag check is still dead, misleading code.
